summary: Frontend e2e validation of MOOD for DESIGN™ Journey Continuity™ Phase 2 (iteration 96) — atmospheric JourneyContextHeader™ extension to satellite modules + Milestone Immersion™ rail refinements. All 14 acceptance criteria PASS. (1) JCH absent on /inspirations/materials without ?project (atmospheric, not always-on). (2) JCH renders on /inspirations/materials?project=<id> showing 'Apartment — Stefano' → 'Inspirations™' → cinematic pill 'Direzione approvata' (project's current milestone resolved via /api/journeys/context/by-entity, as intended). (3) Same passes for /inspirations?project=<id>. (4) JCH atomicity: ZERO <button> inside data-testid='journey-context-header', no operational lexicon ('Marca come', 'Aggiorna stato', 'Chiudi', 'Update status' all absent). (5) Journey CTA continuity verified — dj-focus-open from material_direction rail item navigates to /inspirations/materials?project=79d96981-1ef4-4052-ae27-ff1252e00f3c&from=journey and JCH strip immediately renders. (6) moodboard_direction CTA navigates to /moodboards?project=<id>&from=journey (listing page — acceptance allows either /moodboards or /moodboards/<id>). (7) jch-back-to-journey & jch-project-link both href='/workspace/projects/<id>' clean — NO ?tab query, lands on Journey default tab. (8) Cinematic fade: .dj-focus__head computed animation-name='dj-cinematic-fade', duration=0.46s. (9) Architectural spine: .dj-rail__list::before exists as 1px vertical white-alpha gradient; .dj-rail__item.is-current .dj-rail__btn::before is 2px gold gradient halo (rgb(217,178,133)). (10) Editorial vocabulary in JCH uses cinematic labels only — verified 'Direzione approvata' rendered, no bare 'In lavorazione'/'Presentata'/'Approvata' leaks. (11) Iter94/95 regression: 10 rail items present, dj-absorption-header present, /moodboards/<id> editor JCH still renders 'Moodboard Direction™'. (12) Forbidden lexicon scan across 3 satellite pages — zero hits. (13) Responsive @720x900 — no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=720), jch-back display:none confirmed via getComputedStyle. (14) Zero pageerror in any flow; only background 404/401 from notification polling unrelated to journey UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Acceptance allows the moodboard_direction Journey CTA to navigate either to /moodboards (listing) or /moodboards/<id> (editor). Current behaviour goes to /moodboards listing with the ?project=<id>&from=journey params correctly appended. JCH does not render on the listing (no satellite hook), but the editor route /moodboards/<id> renders JCH correctly (verified via regression). Consider whether a future polish should deep-link to the most recent moodboard for that project to preserve full editor continuity — non-blocking.
JourneyContextHeader.jsx (123 lines) is well-scoped, atomic, and respects the 'no buttons / atmospheric only' contract. No code-review concerns.
Pre-existing veng instrumentation 401/404 console noise persists (unrelated to this iteration).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter96 is approved end-to-end. The JCH ATMOSPHERIC contract (no buttons, no operational text) is enforced in JourneyContextHeader.jsx and confirmed empirically. Status pill on satellite modules uses cinematic vocabulary ('Direzione approvata', 'Evoluzione in corso', etc.) while the Journey tab keeps the bare transition labels — by design. This is correct and matches the request.
